meta.title: GBA Games
meta.description: Play Game Boy Advance with an mGBA WebAssembly core: a 245-title online store of community games that download and start on one click, plus your own .gba cartridges. Battery saves, five save-state slots, auto snapshots, fast-forward, rebindable keys, and a floating player that stays on screen while you work (Ctrl+Alt+G shows it, Ctrl+Q is the boss key).
